meta.title: Pricing — Mobilcab
meta.description: Now: free app + Founding Partner waitlist. When subscriptions open: the paid Basic plan with 20% off for FP; later, full list price.

hero.label: Pricing
hero.title: Free now. 20% FP when subscriptions open. Then list price.
hero.body: Use the app for free — full design and cut list, with no export limits until subscriptions open. If you want 20% off the Basic plan then, join the Founding Partner waitlist. Anyone who subscribes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. We announce list amounts at paid launch.

callout.title: New here?
callout.body: Founding Partner means a free waitlist sign-up now and 20% off the Basic plan when we open subscriptions — with no obligation. Anyone who comes later pays list price.

fpYearly: Founding Partner: 20% off list, 6 months from first payment
cancel: No contract — cancel anytime (once subscriptions exist)

free.name: Free plan
free.for: To use Mobilcab on your own projects until we open paid plans.
features: Exports and cut list without limits (until subscriptions open)
On a laptop, in the browser
At subscriptions: 3 downloads per account on Free

basic.name: Basic plan
basic.for: At paid launch: design, cut lists, sheet nesting, labels and quotes. FP waitlist: 20% off; later: list price.

more.title: More detail
more.body: How Free differs from Basic, what’s included at paid launch, and how Founding Partner works — on the FAQ page.

note: We don't charge until paid plans open. Until then: Free is full on design and cut list. At subscriptions, Free gets 3 downloads per account. List prices are announced then. The FP discount (20%, 6 months) is only for people on the Founding Partner waitlist.
